question: Why are ordinary worldly impressions explained differently from those arising by the descent of power?
premises: Worldly impressions are shaped by earlier deep habituation.
The Lord of Serpents taught this in a sutra.
That teaching refers to such impressions appearing in vulnerable openings.
inference: Ordinary worldly impressions have a karmic-habitual origin, unlike manifestations attributed to the descent of power.
uncertainties: The cited sutra is not named explicitly beyond the reference to the Lord of Serpents.
plain_english: Ordinary worldly impressions are formed by long, deep habituation from the past. As the Lord of Serpents said in the sutra, they appear in those openings.
